reviewers.summary: The fix adds a polyline and verifies live directions through the adapter. The menu-close callback still misses a repeated confirmation after clearing the marker, and the SVG does not map hangar coordinates into its viewport.

findingList.message: Menu close is skipped when the same entry is confirmed again after marker becomes null. Reset the confirmation key when the marker clears, and cover this transition.

evidence.codePathTraced: The effect does nothing when marker is null, so confirmedKeyRef keeps its previous key. When that same marker and aircraft ID are confirmed again, the equality check skips the menu-close callback.
evidence.failureScenario: After confirming a rack entry, clearing marker to null, reopening the rack menu, and confirming the same entry again, the route is confirmed but the menu remains open.

findingList.message: The polyline is present but raw hangar coordinates are rendered in the SVG's default viewport, clipping negative coordinates and leaving world-scale routes tiny or outside the viewport. Map the route bounds into a suitable viewBox or coordinate transform.

evidence.codePathTraced: The polyline receives raw hangar world coordinates, but its parent SVG has no viewBox or explicit dimensions. The default SVG viewport uses a 300 by 150 coordinate space beginning at (0, 0).
evidence.failureScenario: For the tested route from (-4, -4) to (4, -4), negative coordinates are clipped and the remaining segment is only a few default viewport units long, so users do not see a usable guide line.

reviewers.summary: The polyline is now rendered, and the adapter test checks the live region after an accepted keyboard step. Menu closure is verified only when a callback is explicitly supplied; the repository has no production call site wiring that callback to the rack menu.

findingList.message: Menu closure remains opt-in and is not wired to the rack menu in the production path. Confirming a rack entry without a close callback leaves the menu open, so the menu-close acceptance criterion remains unmet.

evidence.codePathTraced: The marker effect calls a menu-close callback only when one of the optional closeMenu, onMenuClose, or onCloseMenu props is supplied. No production call site for HangarGuideLineAdapter exists in the repository; the test supplies closeMenu explicitly.
evidence.failureScenario: When a rack entry is confirmed without one of those props, the route updates but the callback is undefined and the rack menu stays open.

reviewers.summary: The fix adds menu-close handling, renders the route as an SVG polyline, and asserts the live-region text after an accepted keyboard step. I found no security vulnerability in the reviewed change.
